messages.author: b418fa99bb00f5cd
messages.subject: Multiday data problem
parts:
Dear Vincent,

Is it possible (and by which software?) to merge two bin files, i.e. the seven days and the subsequent eeg night in our case?
This would theoretically circumvent our multi-day-data problem by allowing us to subsequently set nrnights to 8 and have the missing time for the tasks in the lab displayed as no wear time (or missing?).

Am I right with this consideration?

kind regards

Markus

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Multiday data problem
parts:
If you want to merge .bin files then probably best to contact the manufacturer.
In relation to GGIR one solution may be to export the data to .csv files, and append those .csv files into one big files. The main challenge then is to account for the time gaps between the files.

Best,
Vincent
